sources.title: GitHub - LAION-AI/CLAP: Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining
sources.snippet: With CLAP, you can extract a latent representation of any given audio and text for your own model, or for different downstream tasks. All codes are comming officially with the following paper, accepted by IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing, ICASSP 2023: Large-Scale Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining with Feature Fusion and Keyword-to-Caption ...
